text:
rachel: heads up - after the TLS hardening deploy at 03:40 UTC some mTLS handshakes are failing in eu-central and us-west-2
omar: seeing client cert validation errors in proxy logs: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` then `unable to locate KMS key metadata`
tina: which change? I merged the TLS profile bump in #4387 to enforce TLS1.3-only and AEAD cipher suites, plus a prerun hook that checks key metadata via `kms:DescribeKey`
kev: we also applied a narrow RBAC rule removing `kms:DescribeKey` from the `proxy-introspect` role earlier in the maintenance window to reduce metadata exposure
omar: that means proxies can't fetch key state during handshake flow where we validate ephemeral key ARNs against key policy -> proxies reject clients that present ephemeral certs tied to rotated keys
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T03:40:12Z: apps/proxy v4.2.1 - TLS profile strict-mode enabled
oncall: impact: ~120 failed handshakes over 7m, partial retries increased request latency for some customers
rachel: mitigation: (1) rollback TLS strict-mode to previous profile (2) restore `kms:DescribeKey` to proxy-introspect role as scoped temporary allow (3) bump audit sampling for mtls_events in affected regions to 25%
tina: rolling back TLS change now -> `helm upgrade proxy --set tls.profile=compat`
kev: applying temporary IAM patch: `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name proxy-introspect --policy-document file://temp-describekey.json` that grants `kms:DescribeKey` scoped to `arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:111122223333:key/*` and similar for us-west-2
omar: after rollback and temp policy, handshakes recovered in eu-central within ~40s, us-west-2 recovered ~55s
audit-bot: note: default mtls_event sampling was 2% and redaction removed `kms_key_arn` and `cert_thumbprint`. Recommended: during incidents store unredacted mtls_event payloads in secure-audit-bucket with envelope encryption and 60d retention
kev: follow-ups: (A) RBAC change process update - any removal of `kms:DescribeKey` must run `./scripts/find-proxies-using-role.sh` and a canary that validates ephemeral cert unwrap + policy check (B) add CI policy lint to flag PRs that revoke DescribeKey from roles matching `proxy*`
tina: also add a TLS rollout playbook step: run handshake canary that sends both modern and compatibility client certs to avoid unexpected client breakage when tightening profiles
oncall: evidence to collect: proxy logs (pre/post), IAM policy diff, helm chart diff, cloudtrail KMS errors, sample unredacted mtls_events for window [-15m,+15m]
rachel: filing incident INC-2026-0533 and assigning postmortem to @tina and @kev. Please upload artifacts and the temp policy to the ticket
kev: will draft RBAC checklist and a minimal `mtls-introspect-temp` policy template for canaries
omar: I'll author the canary job that runs `openssl s_client` variations and verifies KMS metadata queries succeed before promoting TLS profile changes
audit-bot: recorded recommendations: sampling override API: `POST /audit/overrides {match: "event:mtls_event AND region:eu-central-1", rate: 0.25, ttl: "6h"}` and retention change for secure-audit-bucket
tina: scheduling 30m follow-up warroom at 07:30 UTC to review postmortem draft and CI lint PR
rachel: thanks everyone, closing this thread once artifacts are attached :thumbsup:
